listing.name: Super Smash Bros. (Smash Bros. Recompiled)
listing.summary: A Windows port of the original Super Smash Bros. Set it up with your own US Nintendo 64 game file.

steps.title: Prepare your Windows copy
steps.instruction: Use a complete Windows x64 copy that you are permitted to use. Install the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 Redistributable (x64) if needed. Open SmashBrosRecompiled.exe, choose Load ROM and select your own 16 MiB, big-endian Super Smash Bros. USA .z64 (SHA-1 e2929e10fccc0aa84e5776227e798abc07cedabf). Choose Start Game.

warnings: Keep the profile that contains your SRAM and settings. Changing portable mode does not move existing data.

references.title: Setup instructions for the inspected release

listing.download_block_reason: Portcove downloads are paused until the applicable permission for the bundled Fontworks Chiaro fonts is established or upstream publishes a package with appropriately licensed replacements. You can add a complete copy you are permitted to use.

data_locations: %LOCALAPPDATA%/SmashBrosRecompiled by default, or the game folder if it already uses portable.txt
